name: Ehime

flag.description: A wide green band between two yellow-orange bands, with a white citrus blossom in the center.
flag.symbolism: The mandarin orange blossom is the prefectural flower; white stands for simplicity, green for peace and hope, and yellow for happiness.

hook: Ehime is the only striped prefecture flag: orange, green, orange, with a white citrus blossom, for its mandarin groves.
trivia: Dōgo Onsen in Matsuyama is one of Japan's oldest hot springs.
The Shimanami Kaidō bridges link Ehime to Hiroshima across the islands of the Seto Inland Sea.
